# Model card for LibriTTS (high)

dataset.name: LibriTTS corpus (SLR60)
dataset.description_span: It is derived from the original materials (mp3 audio files from LibriVox and text files from Project Gutenberg) of the LibriSpeech corpus.
dataset.citation: Heiga Zen, Viet Dang, Rob Clark, Yu Zhang, Ron J. Weiss, Ye Jia, Zhifeng Chen and Yonghui Wu, "LibriTTS: A Corpus Derived from LibriSpeech for Text-to-Speech", arXiv, 2019.

speaker.note: One of the 904 reader voices in the training data, identified there only by a number. Not an inductee, and not chosen to resemble anyone.
